biography.value:

Dossier

Lower-tier household steward; affectionate, practical, and unwilling to confuse family loyalty with moral immunity.

◆ ◈ ◆

features.name: Household Authority
features.description: Among Lowhearth households, Heddra can usually secure a hearing, shelter, food, or a messenger without a roll unless doing so creates serious danger.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

Military engineer, Heddra’s daughter and Thorgrinn’s cousin. Concealed a safety warning and must decide whether technical service can be ethical.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Pressure Ward
actions.description: Reaction: reduce damage to an adjacent creature or mechanism by 1d10+4.

features.name: Master Engineer
features.description: Advantage on checks concerning pumps, pressure networks, dwarven engineering, and runic mechanisms.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

Thorgrinn’s brother. Still carries the repaired childhood shield. His arc is accountability, not secret possession or predetermined redemption.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Hold With Me
actions.description: Bonus Action: one willing ally within 10 feet has advantage on its next attack before Baldrik’s next turn.

actions.name: The Old Shield
actions.description: Reaction: reduce damage to an adjacent willing ally by 2d8+4.

actions.name: Second Wind
actions.description: Once per encounter, regain 25 HP as a bonus action.

features.name: Vanguard Captain
features.description: Baldrik can coordinate disciplined Ironfist soldiers but does not possess supernatural authority over civilians or PCs.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

Marshal-General responsible for Last Bastion. A political antagonist who remains vulnerable to evidence, lawful removal, surrender, and ordinary player solutions.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Redeploy
actions.description: Bonus Action: two willing allies within 30 feet may use reactions to move 15 feet.

actions.name: Parry
actions.description: Reaction: +3 AC against one visible melee attack.

actions.name: Legendary — Reposition
actions.description: Move 15 feet, provoking normally. Two legendary actions per round.

actions.name: Legendary — Strike
actions.description: Costs 2 legendary actions.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

Defence general. Can become a principled ally when shown both credible evidence and a workable defence plan.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Hold the Line
actions.description: Reaction: when an ally within 10 feet would be pushed, knocked prone, or moved, Brynja grants advantage on the save/check and may move 5 feet toward them.

actions.name: Defensive Order
actions.description: Bonus Action: up to PB allies within 30 feet gain +1 AC until the start of Brynja’s next turn while they remain within 5 feet of cover or an ally.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

Contracts and supply general. Motivated by stability, enforceable terms and the question of how everyone eats after the crisis.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Terms of Engagement
actions.description: Once per encounter, Odran can force a 1-round pause in hostilities among creatures willing to hear terms. This is not mind control and fails against creatures determined to continue fighting.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

Righteous Vanguard sergeant seen in Barovia. Pragmatic, disciplined and increasingly concerned about being ordered into politically convenient atrocities.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Form Shield Wall
actions.description: Bonus Action: two adjacent allied soldiers gain +2 AC until one moves away or Dagnner’s next turn.

actions.name: Interpose
actions.description: Reaction: reduce damage to adjacent ally by 1d10+3.

actors.name: Edda, Warden of the Fifth Finger

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

First Ironfist authority the party meets after Barovia. Procedural rather than cruel; values accurate registers and functioning roads.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Gate Discipline
actions.description: Allied guards within 15 feet gain advantage on checks to resist being deceived or rushed through a controlled checkpoint.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

Shrine keeper, veteran medic and advocate for Thorgrinn’s bodily autonomy.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Coalbraid Benediction
actions.description: 3/day, heal an adjacent creature 2d8+4 HP or stabilize it and end frightened.

actions.name: Witness of Stone
actions.description: Advantage on checks to authenticate oaths, burial records, and religious or memorial inscriptions.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

Ninth Sluice foreman and keeper of the gauge record.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Read the Pressure
actions.description: Can identify dangerous changes in a visible pump or gauge without a roll; complex sabotage still requires investigation.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

Records clerk. Not a combatant; a vital witness to how orders and reports moved through the bureaucracy.

◆ ◈ ◆

features.name: Archive Memory
features.description: Advantage on checks to locate an indexed military record or identify a suspicious alteration in a registry.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

War-chief whose grievance is legitimate but whose chosen answer is conquest. Can lose political authority, surrender, or be defeated without reducing his people to extensions of him.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Breaking Roar
actions.description: 15-foot cone; on failure frightened until the end of Korga’s next turn.

actions.name: Brace
actions.description: Reaction: reduce one instance of damage by 1d10+5.

actions.name: Unbroken Will
actions.description: Twice per encounter, when Korga fails a save he may succeed instead and take 20 unavoidable damage.

actions.name: Legendary — Reposition
actions.description: Move 15 feet, provoking normally. Two legendary actions per round.

actions.name: Legendary — Cleave
actions.description: Costs 2 legendary actions.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

Civilian representative demanding water, secure homes, prisoner protections and accountability on both sides.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Hold the Truce
actions.description: Allies who can hear Urzha have advantage on the first check to avoid escalating a negotiation into violence, provided she is actively arguing for restraint.

biography.value:
◆ ◈ ◆

Dossier

Goblin engineer and saboteur. Caused real harm, knows the lower pressure network, and can become Runa’s necessary collaborator.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Remote Bleed Valve
actions.description: 1/short rest, manipulate a visible pressure mechanism within 30 feet as though adjacent if he has studied its controls.

actions.name: Flash Charge
actions.description: 10-foot radius; half on successful save.

Dossier

Tunnel captain used at the Ninth Sluice and comparable officer encounters. Mission-focused, not suicidal.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Rally
actions.description: Once per encounter, two allies within 30 feet gain 10 temporary HP and may use reactions to move 10 feet.

actions.name: Punish an Opening
actions.description: Reaction: after an adjacent enemy misses with a melee attack, make one Tunnel Blade attack.

Dossier

Goblin sapper who can serve as captive, witness, engineer or recurring foe depending on play.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Thunder Charge
actions.description: Visible charge detonates at the start of Ketta’s next turn in a 10-foot radius; an adjacent creature can disable or throw it first.

Ordinary disciplined Ironfist soldier; holds objectives and surrenders when lawfully relieved or clearly abandoned.

actions.name: Cover a Comrade
actions.description: Reaction: +2 AC to one adjacent willing ally against one visible attack.

Elite defender for records, doors and evacuation lanes.

actions.name: Shield Press
actions.description: After a hammer hit, bonus action: push 5 feet or knock prone.

actions.name: Interpose
actions.description: Reaction: reduce damage to an adjacent ally by 1d10+3.

Heavy assault fighter used to clear routes for engineers.

actions.name: Press the Line
actions.description: Bonus Action: move 15 feet toward a visible hostile creature; first hit against it this turn deals +1d6 damage.

Dossier

Objective-focused engineer and saboteur.

◆ ◈ ◆

actions.name: Thunder Charge
actions.description: Visible charge; 10-foot radius; can be thrown or disabled before detonation.

Dossier

Heartworks guardian/control engine. A hazard with hit points, not a moral person and not powered by Thorgrinn or any captive soul.

actions.name: Scalding Vent
actions.description: 20-foot line of superheated steam; half on success.

actions.name: Hydraulic Shock
actions.description: 15-foot radius; on failure pushed 15 feet and knocked prone.

actions.name: Locked Instruction
actions.description: The engine stops attacking when all three regulator stations are completed or its operating state is otherwise safely disabled. It contains no captive soul.
